lines.10: 「You were looking out for me and giving Tsushima all kinds of instructions, weren't you?」
lines.11: 「I did no such thing. I merely arranged a helper for the drama club.」
lines.16: 「Yes. At every turn, he said it was Kurogane-senpai's orders.」
lines.17: 「That boy... I taught him not to lie.」
lines.18: 「Heh... Well, I suppose there are extenuating circumstances this time.」
lines.20: 「Basically, he wanted to help you but was too embarrassed to admit it, so he used my name and pretended he was only doing it reluctantly.」
lines.23: 「Oh... I see. So that's what it was.」
lines.24: 「Think a little better of Leo now?」
lines.26: 「B-but the way he thinks is fundamentally wrong! As long as he doesn't fix that, nothing else he does matters!」
lines.27: 「Ha ha. If you think even a little better of him, that's enough.」
